votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the 16 by 4 rolling dock at 205 Sunset Lane (John Harrison), with the stairs condition RB outlined.
votes.quote: bp moved to issue the negative determination with the condition of the stairs rb had outlined. cl seconded and the commission unanimously approved by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue an Order of Conditions for K & E Realty Trust's addition at 5 Electric Ave, with MM's addition.
votes.quote: kj moved to issue and order of conditions with mm's addition cl seconded and the commission voted a roll call unanimous approval.

votes.motion: Approve and issue a standard Order for the bridge repair and reconstruction at 181 Kilburn Street (Steven Violette / Christopher Environmental).
votes.quote: kj moved to approve and issue a standard order.cl seconded and the commission voted unanimously to approve the motion by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue the Order for the Borrego solar facility at 190 Electric Avenue with the additional conditions MM noted (50/50 wildflower mix, third party inspector).
votes.quote: cl moved to issue with the additional conditions that mm noted. kj seconded and the commission voted unanimously by roll call vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Approve an Order of Conditions for the single family home at 150 Cross Road (RCL Realty Trust II), with the additional conditions discussed.
votes.quote: a motion with the aforementioned additional conditions being added to approve an order of conditions by kj and a second by bp with a unanimous roll call vote by the commission approving the motion.

votes.motion: Continue the Nanci Bell Notice of Intent at 51 Fire Road 19 to April 3, 2019 at the applicant's request.
votes.quote: by motion of kj and a second by cc. the commission voted a roll call unanimous approval

votes.motion: Grant an extension of Order LSCI 208-1064 to June 6, 2019.
votes.quote: the extension was granted to june 6, 2019 by motion of bp with a second by kj and a unanimous roll call vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of February 20 and March 6, 2019, with the amendment to the March 6 minutes proposed by RB.
votes.quote: the minutes with the amendment was approved by a motion of bp and a second by cc with unanimous roll call vote to approve.
the meeting was adjourned at 9:38 pm with a motion from bp and a second by cc and unanimous roll call vote to approve the motion.
